name: Dreamwalker: Tier 3 — The Walking Lane (Signature Mode)

description.value:
Tier 3 — The Walking Lane (Signature Mode). Stance. While the Lane is open, your sustained manifestations reach into adjacent realms (astral / dream / memory) — ignore one band of cover or distance for any one effect per round, and the GM is invited to attach a narrative hook (someone notices you went somewhere). Pays ongoing upkeep.

Discipline (mode dwWalkingLane): while ON, no engine deltas (the Lane is narrative reach + GM hint at this pilot stage). Click this feature on the sheet to toggle the stance.

Pilot: lock exact upkeep curve and break condition after one playtest cycle.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — The Walking Lane
Recovery: Stance (signature)  ·  Action: Action (open / drop)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
